作为聚焦“生死哲思+忠犬寻主”的人文向独立佳作，本作以中华传统生死观为内核，用写意水墨画风与治愈又伤感的叙事，打造了一场直击人心的冥界冒险，堪称小众游戏中“以情动人”的典型代表。游戏的视觉表达极具韵味，手绘水墨风格勾勒出黄泉路、三生石等中式冥界场景，曼珠沙华点缀的幽暗路径与古朴建筑相得益彰，搭配中国传统乐器演奏的空灵配乐，完美烘托出“静谧肃穆又暗藏温情”的氛围，每一处细节都贴合“里有殡，不巷歌”的传统意境。
核心亮点在于情感与主题的深度共鸣：玩家以忠诚狗狗的视角闯入冥界，为追寻已故主人的亡魂踏上旅程，途中不仅会遇到等待恋人999年的执念灵魂，还能通过对话与互动感受亡灵对阳间的眷恋。剧情没有复杂转折，却用“奶奶劝慰狗狗好好活下去”等生活化对话戳中泪点，双结局设定更是将情感张力拉满——是追随主人永伴左右，还是遵从嘱托回到家人身边，两种选择都承载着对“离别与坚守”的深层思考，尤其能引发养宠人士与经历过生死离别的玩家共鸣。解谜设计简洁温和，以物品收集、简单互动为主，无过高难度门槛，让玩家能专注于情感体验与主题感悟。
短板同样突出：主线流程极短，30-40分钟即可通关双结局，与定价相比显得内容体量不足；解谜机制简单且缺乏创意，部分谜题被玩家吐槽“无聊且愚蠢”，游戏性较弱；操作设定僵化，仅支持键盘固定按键操控且无法自定义，部分场景互动判定不够流畅；剧情叙事过于碎片化，角色情感铺垫不足，年轻玩家或无相似经历者较难产生深度共鸣。
它更像一部承载情感与文化的互动短片，而非传统意义上的解谜游戏。尽管在玩法体量与操作打磨上存在明显短板，但真挚的情感表达、唯美的水墨画风与对生死主题的细腻探讨，仍使其具备独特的价值。尤其适合喜欢沉浸式叙事、偏爱人文主题的玩家，在短短一小时的体验中，感受忠诚与牵挂的重量，体会传统文化中对死亡的温柔解读。

在我看来，游戏并不做的并不算好。但是为什么仍旧这么多好评呢？
 [h1]大家在这样一个题材中，在这一个故事里，想起了属于自己的故事 [/h1]
[strike]或许就这一点而言，也算一个好游戏？[/strike]
游戏交的答卷并不算好，但是选题本身确实出彩，[b]它让人们忽视了游戏本身，而思绪早已代入那个属于自己的，感动的故事。[/b]
可惜，我并不是一个有类似故事的人，那么对我而言，抛去诸多主观因素，评价只能是如此：

不推荐，如果给分的话大概40分左右。
9月份看到推荐，点进来后被标题和简介吸引，顺手买的。游戏全程大概半小时左右，在最后有两个结局选择。
优点：水墨画风，故事结局还不错，音乐尚可，cg很不错。
缺点：感觉不到游戏性。解密生硬，为了解密而解密。支线突兀，毫无铺垫突然开始突然结束。非常半成品的感觉。很多地方莫名其妙。

 [h2] [b]以下将是吐槽：[/b] 含有剧透 [/h2]
[spoiler] 哦先把这句拿出来， [i]在含蓄内敛的东方文化中。 [/i]，这句我看了是真难蚌。
开篇cg是奶奶去世，葬礼吊唁。这一段做的很不错，彩墨画风也很好看。不过感觉场景已经有点奇怪了，一秒城市一秒乡村的感觉   [i]（跳转太快，感觉全乡村样式更合适） [/i]。 [u]不过这里总体还算不错，特别是阳间到阴间转场也很好。 [/u]
然后呢？开始莫名其妙起来了。我不懂为什么开局要来一个钓叟变青面恶鬼。去往阴间路上先来一个下马威，把狗子吓跑是吧 。
跑到阴阳关口，好嘛，果然。看到牛皮癣广告啊官吏骂人啊，“含蓄内敛”，这阴间果然和阳间一样啊。阴阳没有差别，非常符合中国古典小说这些，阴间人情世故什么的就是另一个阳间。嗯，这里解密也还好，符纸蘸血。不过，过关有点太离谱了。狠狠吐槽。嗯？官吏拦着门，旁边莫名其妙人跑开，然后狗子就能挖洞过去？好嘛你这里能挖洞，是不是所有拦着的地方全可以挖洞过关啊。
一段不错的黑白场景。跑到了日落黄泉路，开满曼珠沙华的地方。曼珠沙华，我个人感觉会是彩墨最能展现美的地方。然后你这个日暮让全场景黑色一片，我：“啊？”全一片漆黑的影子。孤零零一个小男孩：“我的吉娃娃被抢走啦”。不是，你狗被恶鬼抢走了你去想办法啊，你搁这坐着等另外一条狗帮你忙？狗作用大于人是吧。
一只很大的白色生物拦路，画风很可爱，不错。不过，现在我们要想办法让它别拦路，只能往下走。
望乡台，不做评价。有一种过流程做场景的感觉，我不知道场景的用处是什么。就是演示一遍黄泉路上场景而已？
然后是莫名其妙解密，坐电梯先连线，啊？电梯？-18是地狱18层合理，1层是正常层，-1这个是什么，管理员层？几个恶鬼打牌，一个保险箱，还有恶鬼拦路不让我们拿肉包子。
咱也不明白为什么最上面是316层，为什么三生石在这里。为什么有个卖东西的商人。为什么旁边还有一个望远镜。为什么商人卖恶鬼缺的牌，为什么保险箱密码在一个有一些人的不知道什么地方的墙上要望远镜看。 嗯，主要diss的是望远镜，和黄泉路也太违和了，过于生硬。牌型顺序你在各个地图奇奇怪怪的山上地上提示也就算了。
-1层牌给了牌型顺序对好了，作弊！恶鬼一拥而上把赢了的恶鬼分了。
咱也不明白-18层恶鬼抢到吉娃娃吉娃娃怎么还逃到树上。无所谓了。旁边一个百年没吃肉包子大爷让我们给他拿包子，拿包子给大爷了哟这时候旁边恶鬼终于有反应了，一拥而上。刚刚拿包子经过是一点事情没有的。拿到吉娃娃，终于回去交差了。
回到小男孩那里，吉娃娃给了，那只挡路大白生物（狐狸？）跑了。不是不帮小男孩你就不让路，帮完忙就让开太离谱了。

终于找到奶奶了，终于看到正常的了，选择跟奶奶走还是回到阳间，最后两个结局cg都还是很不错的[/spoiler]

不巷歌让我感慨万千，上个月爷爷刚刚高龄去世，在奶奶离开了七年以后，爷爷也和我告别了。葬礼有很多风俗，我由于外出打工不常在乡土，许多的说道我只有大致揣测其中的含义。最让我印象深刻的是一场过桥的仪式，我们家里的亲人跪在一座纸桥两旁，父亲站在纸桥边，手里提着爷爷的布棉鞋，棉鞋底垫着毛巾放在桥上，要帮着爷爷的魂从桥上走过，纸桥的终点是一个水盆，盆里有一层浅浅的水。伴随着吹打的乐器和道士们的颂读，父亲把爷爷送到了桥对岸，仪式完成了，大家开始帮着收起东西，父亲怀里还揣着那双棉鞋无所适从，在那站定着，道士们告诉他把鞋放到棺材前面的贡品台上就好，亲戚们说他是还舍不得爷爷，放不下来。也许他和我一样愕然，那座桥大概就是奈何桥吧，过完这座桥要把亲人忘掉吗？我们在世时常悼念追忆故人，而故人只留存在我们记忆中，再无别的实证，也再无产生关联的可能......只能后悔没有多相处，没有更多记忆。
我之前常常担心爷爷能不能坚持到百岁大关，如今看来还差了几个年头，可惜的是意外身故，被火灾浓烟呛伤了。这个世界有太多的意外，陪伴爷爷奶奶的狗，也在前两年出了车祸，在家门口的乡间路上被车撞死。那是我们在08年前后收养的土狗，就是大雪飘飘那一年，我还记得和狗在白雪覆盖的田地里奔跑的日子，那天我们倒在雪原上，觉得这个世界都本应如此平整洁白。
话说回来这款游戏，内容简单流程短，里面的元素可以帮助理解丧葬文化，游玩时不禁思绪弥漫，怀想故旧。

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

Эту необычную историю сопровождает красивая акварельная рисовка и приятная меланхоличная музыка. Головоломки тут достаточно простые, также есть несколько концовок. Don't Disturb is a simple 2D adventure game where you guide a Chinese dog through the afterlife in search of a dead master.  Certainly a whimsical and sad topic for a game, and the artwork itself is tasteful if simplistic (but on-message, so that's ok I guess). 

The problems with this game really are just that it might as well be a browser/Flash game, it's very simplistic and doesn't take any advantage of the PC gaming platform, and the plethora of technical problems, some of which spring from the very poor choice of game engine.

There's no English translation for the game (that I could find, anyway), but that's ok.  It turns out, the language of bad games is universal.

From a technical perspective, the game doesn't meet basic minimum requirements that most PC gamers expect as standard.

There's no options to change the resolution for the game or customise the graphics settings.  There's no way for gamers to ensure this is running at the native resolution of their displays... there's no guarantee this game will look right on any PC as a result of this hamfisted design decision.  There's no way for gamers to try improve the low quality graphics. 

The implementation here is of such poor quality, the developer couldn't work out how to make the game display in fullscreen, it only runs in a window.

The controls can't be customised, which will be an annoyance for many, but it can also render the game unplayable for differently-abled gamers.

Some of the defects in the game can be attributed to the choice of using the Construct 2/Construct 3 game engine/toolset.  This is a very poor quality toolset sometimes used by amateur developers as it doesn't require advanced game development skills, but unfortunately has very limited capabilities (it's worse than GameMaker Studio!).  Just as you can't make a silk purse out of a sows ear, you can't make a great video game if you use a terrible engine.

These technical defects push this game below acceptable standards for any modern PC game.

Reviewing SteamDB to check how popular this game was with players reveals a surprise... there's a very healthy spike in player counts for the game.  But this only appears around the same time that trading cards were applied to the game... so this is just card idlers getting their cards and moving on.  A closer look at the numbers shows the game just has a couple of players every week running up the game and idling it for cards, then deleting it.  We must ask how it benefits gamers for there to be so many games like this, with no merit as a serious game, that only generate sales from people idling and selling the trading cards.

Don't Disturb has the over optimistic price of around $4 USD, it's not worth it given the defects and shortcomings with the product.

After reading about twenty of the top reviews, I knew what I'd be getting into - something potentially quite buggy, with a very poor English translation, but with beautiful art. Still, for the £0.26 I paid (during a sale), I thought this was worth a shot.

First of all - yes, the art is gorgeous, I really enjoyed the visuals of each scene. For what is clearly a small-scale title on a tight budget (e.g. having almost no animation for background NPCs!), they did an outstanding job. I can't speak about the cultural context of ESEA art due to my own lack of knowledge, so it's possible there might be issues I didn't spot, but it was certainly a striking and evocative aesthetic style.

[b]It contains some brief sections with sudden flashing lights, so if you have photosensitive epilepsy you should probably give this one a miss to be safe.[/b]

I didn't encounter any bugs, which was a pleasant surprise. The one time I chose to save (on the bridge at the end, the decision point for which ending you get) worked fine. I was able to load it back up and choose differently to get the alternative ending, no problem.

I was expecting translation issues and sure enough I got them. There was awkward phrasing, bizarre formatting mistakes (several instances of the final letter of an English word randomly set on a new line? What?), one dialogue bubble from the merchant accidentally left in the source language... It could really have done with a copy edit by a native speaker of English.

However, I was unexpectedly disappointed in the writing's [i]content[/i] (or rather the lack of it). The characters are extremely flat - if they get any dialogue at all it's usually just to hint at a solution to a relevant puzzle nearby, or to explain the function of this area of the afterlife. Admittedly I was playing the English translation, so perhaps the original is better or has subtext/symbolic meaning that I missed, but the overt meaning of the text seemed awfully dull. I feel that this game could have easily been a 7/10 if there had been decent writing, but I guess the devs lacked the budget or skills to make the writing match up to their artistic prowess - at least definitely in the English version. 

This particularly frustrated me as I'd taken the store page's promise of a "carefully crafted story [that] explores the traditional Asian views on the afterlife and the underworld" at face value and I was hoping to learn more about what these views (as in perspectives and ideas) might be. However, all I really got was some scenic views (as in art) of locations in the afterlife that apparently served a variety of purposes, according to brief text bubbles of exposition. It feels more accurate to describe it as "a wholesome story of a dog trying to return to his recently-deceased owner by trekking through a representation of the afterlife that is inspired by some traditional Asian views of it".

The store page also claims "On the way you will need to make decisions that will determine how the tale ends." This is massively stretching the truth. There is a linear sequence of puzzles you need to complete in order to get to the end, and the only decision you make that affects the ending is whether to walk right (towards your owner's spirit) or left (back to the world of the living). That is all the choice there is in this game. At minimum, this description should be amended to read "a decision" rather than "decisions".

The store page says that "Don't Disturb is an unforgettable and gorgeous story that players will both relate to and be surprised by." I can't say I agree. While I could relate to the ([i]very[/i] basic treatment of) universal themes of bereavement and loss, and the gorgeous art did inspire a feeling of awe and curiosity that was appropriate for the afterlife setting, the plot is still extremely simple and forgettable. Nothing in it particularly surprised me (except perhaps the possibly-achillean lovers who appear for about twenty seconds of content). Despite the storepage's claim that completing tasks would let the player "learn tales", there was very little in the way of story reward for completing most puzzles. The beautiful visuals (and the sheer cuteness of the cut-scenes and art with the dog and its humans) will probably stick with me enough to give me a fond memory of this game, but I wouldn't call it unforgettable.

[b]Overall, this is worth picking up on a deep-discount sale if you're curious about it, but don't let the storepage mislead you.[/b] It is very short and simple, and the English version's writing is very poor, but it's a pleasant enough way to spend 15-30 minutes if you want to see all of the art for the story and do some simple puzzles on the way.

[h1]“在另一个时空，我们总会失忆着相聚。”[/h1]
这则标题，来自赵雷演唱的《我记得》。
很多人认为，生死是一场场轮回。每一世我们都会重逢，然后短暂地分别直到下一世再会，只是每次再会，我们都忘了过去的一切。
奈何桥上，我可回到阳间，带着对你的思念继续属于我的冒险；亦可不顾你的”驱赶“奔向你的身边，陪你走完这一世轮回，我不知你是否喝下了孟婆汤，但我清楚你并未忘记我。可唯独，我不能带你往回走，肉身已然衰破，孤魂无法立于阳间。我只得祈求下一世我们还能再会，哪怕你不记得我。
不禁想起驾鹤西去一年有余的太公。
我太公，可以说是生前家里最疼爱我的。22年元宵的早上，伴着第一缕阳光，他在睡梦中摆脱了癌症的痛苦。
下葬时，我的家人泣不成声，我面无表情，眼神空洞，自寒假归家以来，我一直陪伴着他，不曾有什么遗憾，只是感叹太公走时没有那么受太多折磨。
那年清明，在学校，早上猛地一下惊醒坐了起来，擦干了眼角的泪痕，这次的梦永生难忘：他在梦里牵着我的手，带我逛年货集市，说给我买点好吃的。他穿着他生前最爱穿的那一身打扮，左手提着一大袋子各种年货，右手牵着我，慢悠悠走在望不到头的集市，只是看不清那张脸。
腊月廿五早上，天还不亮，又是惊醒，擦干眼角的泪，同样永生难忘：外面下着小雪，他依然穿着那身打扮，两手提着两盒红盒子的点心，像以往一样回到家里，但这次，他的脸非常清晰。他说，快过年了，回家吃顿饭，想我们了。我们抱着他泣不成声，我也带着泪水在摸黑的早上醒来。
自此，至今，再未梦见他。不知是怕我再哭泣思念，还是看我工作稳定不再担心，亦或是喝下了孟婆汤再度回到了阳间。
也许未来某日，我们会再度相见，只是我们都不知道。

Oyun, ölü sahibini aramak için öbür dünyada dolaşan yalnız bir köpeğin duygusal hikayesini anlatıyor. Oyunun çarpıcı 2D sanat tarzı, oyuncuların bulmacaları çözmek ve beklenmedik karşılaşmalar yapmak için gezinmeleri gereken güzel ama gizemli bir yeraltı dünyası yaratıyor.

Genel olarak, "Don't Disturb" oyunculara geleneksel Asya kültürlerinin ölüm ve ölümden sonraki yaşam hakkındaki görüşlerine bir bakış sunan benzersiz ve unutulmaz bir oyun deneyimidir. 打折时2.7入手的。感觉原价贵了点。

“喝下这碗汤，就不会记得我是谁了。
但我的孩子会帮我记得。”

以狗狗的视角去找寻去世的奶奶，双结局但依旧觉得[spoiler]追随奶奶而去[/spoiler]结局更深刻，虽然两边的心情我都能感同身受，但如果是我的话还是能和爱的人在一起更为重要，很久以前我问过我妈妈延长爱的人的死亡时间值得吗，她说如果是我的话也会选择这么做。
流程很短将近半小时的流程，淡雅水墨风格表现东方死亡空间，平淡悠扬的古琴BGM，交互点有点不太准确但不影响解谜体验，每个人都有自己生前的执念，无论是希望来世还做一家人的爸爸妈妈，还是努力念博士终究还是得喝汤的学生，还是在十八层地狱心心念念想吃肉包的爷爷，还是奈何桥下不喝孟婆汤只为等待999天的恋人...我从这里开始鼻子一酸，直到在扑进奶奶怀里那一刻泪如雨下，很精致的国产独立小游戏，平淡的就像死亡一样，唯一的缺点就是情感铺垫不够长又结束得太快，steampy才三块钱是可以闭眼入买来收藏的程度。
明天是我与我的猫相识四周年的一天，我希望它可以来找我，更希望它可以好好活下去。

“你认为死亡能使人分离？”她又说。
“我是说......”
“我的想法正相反，死亡使人们相互接近，是的，使活着时分离的人们相互接近。”
————安德烈 · 纪德《窄门》
很温馨的小故事，死亡变得不冰冷了。喝了孟婆汤走过奈何桥就能见到狗狗奶奶，很短很暖啊
Jednoduchý příběh, ve kterém se jeden pes rozhodne hledat svoji zesnulou paničku, s moc pěknou kresbou <3
流程很短，玩完也可以退款，不过也可以收藏就是了，打折入的，半小时通关，音乐跟画面确实不错，交互校准不太准，感情还没酝酿到位就结束了，比较简单的小故事。
游戏是以狗的视角去游玩的，狗狗不舍的奶奶想下去陪她，最后有两个选择。我选的是陪着奶奶。整部游戏画风、音乐尚可，唯一遗憾的就是不够玩，就结局了。。
